note: B21 Aéroport exterior, seen from the top end of the Boulevard des Départs (poplars). White terminal with a paper-aeroplane roof, control tower and windsock on the right, small plane on the grass left. Open glass doors -> R_airport; the paved path back down the boulevard -> ST_movement_seg010 (last place of Boulevard des Départs; street not built by this track). Painted 2026-10-22.
